title: Amazing product; lots of feature requests still though!
body:
Thank you so much for this product!

1. Be able to run some commands DURING a query/process/inference run, such as /cost
2. Be able to pause and or update the query with fixed and/or additional information (e.g. typed/pasted the wrong thing need to update the inference)
3. You could show a running cost for the session so we don't need to run /cost ever
4. Perma approve certain commands. I find myself approving the same commands over and over. You could also have an option that says approve non-destructive commands (e.g. ls/mkdir/yarn [build,start,run]/ cargo build/ cargo check, etc. and NOT rm).
5. Approve everything for session. Just give it something to do and let it do whatever. Most changes are very easily redone. Maybe don't `rm -rf` though? Which I'm pretty sure if already prevented. Example: I'm integrating to projects; there's tons of moving stuff around and trying to build over and over. I don't want to do this. Just give Code free reign. The goal is to get the AI doing as much stuff as possible

Again, thank you so much for this product!!

#4 and #5 are probably most wanted.
author: JohnAllen
